_instructions: Fill this in by hand after the Claude Desktop chat finishes, using the mapping rules below - matches the automated result.json schema exactly, so grade.py needs no special-casing per environment.

_mapping_rules.root_cause_id: A short kebab-case slug YOU write summarizing Claude's stated cause
_mapping_rules.summary: Paste Claude's final answer verbatim, untrimmed
_mapping_rules.calls_used: Count of MCP tool invocations in the chat, excluding the baseline-sweep-equivalent calls at the start
_mapping_rules.distinct_supporting_tools: Distinct tool names Claude explicitly cites as evidence for its conclusion
_mapping_rules.model_self_reported_confidence: 'inconclusive' if it says it can't determine the cause; 'confirmed' if it states the cause with no hedging; else 'best_guess'
_mapping_rules.confidence: Apply the same rule as the code: downgrade 'confirmed' to 'best_guess' if distinct_supporting_tools has fewer than 2 entries
